alternator-thermactor-common-carrier.summary: A single carrier connects both accessory mounting ears to the engine.
alternator-thermactor-common-carrier.limits: One-piece construction is supported by casting photographs. Exact hole mapping, cast shape, dimensions and load capacity remain provisional; accessory stations and belt fit are unverified.

steps.title: Common casting
steps.text: A continuous support connects the two open cradles, replacing independent bracket studies.

steps.title: Alternator ears
steps.text: Two provisional fasteners connect the alternator drive housing to the upper support.

steps.title: Thermactor ears
steps.text: The lower fasteners attach to the pump front plate, which carries its mounting ears.
